description: This file defines error handling enums, structs, and constants related to gateway connection errors within a networking or communication module. It includes specific error codes, recovery steps, and detailed error structures used for structured error reporting in a WebSocket or similar context.

classes.name: GatewayConnectAuthError
classes.description: Represents an error during gateway connection authentication, including message, detail codes, recovery steps, and retry logic.

classes.name: GatewayResponseError
classes.description: Represents a generic error response from the gateway, including method, code, message, and additional details.

classes.name: GatewayDecodingError
classes.description: Represents an error that occurs during decoding of gateway responses, including method and message.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayConnectAuthError instance with message, detail code, retry capability, and optional recovery step.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.detail
methods.description: Returns the detail code as a GatewayConnectAuthDetailCode enum if possible.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.recommendedNextStep
methods.description: Returns the recommended next step as a GatewayConnectRecoveryNextStep enum if possible.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayResponseError with method, code, message, and details.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayDecodingError with method and message.
